SPEEDBALL II BRUTAL DELUXEAMIGA · 1990
DECODING AMIGA DATA…

Blue: WASD, Space fire, X pass, Tab switch. Red: arrow keys, Enter fire, / pass, . switch. Controllers: stick/D-pad move, A fire, B pass, X switch, Start pause. Press a controller button before starting so the browser can detect it.

Press Fire to begin.

CREDITS & ABOUT

Original game © 1990 The Bitmap Brothers / ImageWorks. Design: Eric Matthews. Code: Rob Trevellyan. Art: Dan Malone. Music: Nation 12. Music code & FX: Richard Joseph.

Media decoded from Simon Frankau’s Amiga reverse-engineering repository. This browser adaptation implements exhibition matches. It is not an emulation or a complete port; AI and physics are approximations. Audio uses a browser port of the original sound driver. League management and transfers use source data and adapted presentation; automatic injury substitutions and promotion playoffs are not implemented.
